guards.all: Trusted app only; current request/cancellation revision, permitted source/admission and active worker lease where needed. No arbitrary model state writes.
guards.READY: Immutable candidate/format selected under an applicable admission; unresolved ambiguous match requires user choice.
guards.SOURCE_VALIDATING: Input bytes complete; source probe remains bounded and separate from final output validation.
guards.CONVERTING: Source validation passed; output settings fixed; original preserved.
guards.VERIFYING: Validate exact final rendition after transfer or transformation. Earlier source validation is insufficient.
guards.PUBLISHING: Final-rendition validation passed; same object identity/hash and selected output.
guards.COMPLETED: Single transaction/CAS checks current request revision, cancellation revision, PUBLISHING state and worker lease; publishes MediaAsset, idempotency outcome, publication and terminal job state together.
guards.CANCEL_REQUESTED: Cancel transaction wins only before terminal publication; increments cancellation revision; publication cannot pass the old fence.
guards.PAUSED_OR_RETRY_WAIT: Resume only the actual durable safe checkpoint with refreshed admission/lease and unchanged media identity; otherwise re-resolve or create a new selected revision.
guards.terminal: No automatic restart. User retry after terminal failure/block creates a new execution revision/key; completed media remains unchanged.
guards.selection_revision: New selection/format receives new immutable revision, digest and key; superseded execution loses its lease and cannot publish.

publication_equalities: publication.managedObjectRef identifies the exact validated final object
